title: Move a rect
prompt: Return the rectangle shifted by offset. Its size does not change.
starter:
func solve(r, offset) -> Rect2:
	return r
hints: Build a new Rect2 from the moved position and the old size.

docs.name: Rect2(x, y, width, height)
docs.what: Makes a rectangle from a top-left corner and a size. Also Rect2(position, size) with two vectors.

docs.name: r.position, r.size, r.end
docs.what: The top-left corner, the width and height, and the bottom-right corner, all Vector2.

solution:
func solve(r, offset) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(r.position + offset, r.size)
